description: This file defines a Data Transfer Object (DTO) class 'UserToDeleteDto' used for user deletion operations within the account module of a book tracking application. It includes annotations for Lombok to generate boilerplate code and a custom annotation to exclude it from Jacoco code coverage reports. The class contains a single field 'password' for user authentication during deletion.

classes.name: UserToDeleteDto
classes.description: A DTO class representing the data required to delete a user, primarily encapsulating the user's password.

methods.name: <constructor>
methods.description: Generated constructors via Lombok annotations for creating instances of UserToDeleteDto.
